purpose: Screen the variable-token MambaACF branch with a separately identified memory contrast, an AutoCon lambda-null relation contrast, and a rank-2 horizon-calibration arm.
evidence_boundary: Exploratory H96 evidence only: two hourly datasets, three seeds, eight epochs, and no test-based selection. The relation null-to-relation contrast is the only registered causal relation contrast.
claim_boundary: Report paired descriptive deltas and invariant checks. Do not pool this matrix with the non-variable fair-baseline screen, call the AutoCon activation contrast causal, or make a publication claim from this screen.

required_before_launch: human review of the variable-token null-control comparison
human review of dataset fingerprints and train-only sidecar policy
explicit launch authorization and a fresh output root

prelaunch_gates: human review of the variable-token null-control comparison
human review of dataset fingerprints and train-only sidecar policy
explicit launch authorization and a fresh output root

MambaACFVariable.provenance_rule: The manifest retains the alias; config.json and --model use the executable MambaACF model after applying these overrides.

MambaACFVariableAutoCon.provenance_rule: The manifest retains the alias; config.json and --model use the executable MambaACFAutoCon model after applying these overrides.

phases.name: variable_memory_off_h96
phases.purpose: Variable-token MambaACF with the same train-only ACF fitting path but forecast memory disabled.

phases.name: variable_memory_on_h96
phases.purpose: Variable-token MambaACF with static train-only raw ACF memory and no relation objective.

phases.name: variable_relation_null_h96
phases.purpose: Same variable-token AutoCon architecture as the relation arm, with lambda exactly zero as the relation null control.

phases.name: variable_relation_h96
phases.purpose: Same variable-token AutoCon architecture as the null arm, with the registered signed global relation weight lambda=0.03.

phases.name: variable_relation_calibrated_h96
phases.purpose: The registered relation arm plus the rank-2 horizon amplitude calibration adapter.

comparison_contract.primary_causal_contrast: variable_relation_h96 minus variable_relation_null_h96; identical MambaACFVariableAutoCon architecture, sidecar, lag sampler, split, optimizer, and budget, differing only in AutoCon_lambda 0.03 versus 0.0.
planned_contrasts: variable_memory_on_h96 minus variable_memory_off_h96 (memory-stage contrast within the plain variable-token branch)
variable_relation_h96 minus variable_relation_null_h96 (only relation causal contrast)
variable_relation_null_h96 minus variable_memory_on_h96 (descriptive AutoCon-activation contrast; confounded by architecture/objective activation)
comparison_contract.confounding_boundary: The memory-on to AutoCon-null comparison changes the executable AutoCon branch and its relation diagnostics; it cannot identify a relation effect. The null-to-lambda=.03 comparison is the required relation control.
comparison_contract.sidecar_contract: All five arms must use the same raw train-only ACF sidecar identity and effective forecast lags at each dataset-seed coordinate; relation arms must additionally agree on relation candidate/effective lags.

calibration_contract.initialization: zero logits; multiplicative amplitude one at initialization

comparison_contract.cross_plan_boundary: Comparison with mamba_acf_fair_baseline_screen_plan.json is descriptive context only. Do not pool paired deltas or claim a variable mixer gain because the plans have different architecture arms and independent provenance.
comparison_contract.publication_claim_boundary: Exploratory evidence only: six coordinates per contrast, short budget, no independent replication, and no test-based selection. A favorable screen requires a separately reviewed frozen replication.

stopping_rules: Do not launch while execution.authorized is false; require human review and a fresh output root.
Stop before launch if plan validation, data fingerprints, alias mapping, or the train-only sidecar contract fails.

Mark a phase invalid if any coordinate is missing or duplicated, any manifest record is not ok, any artifact hash changes, provenance drifts, relation coverage is non-positive, or calibration state violates the rank-2 contract.
Do not rerun or replace failed artifacts in this output root; use a new output root and preserve the failed manifest for audit.

Stop this exploratory program without adding horizons, seeds, lambdas, or selecting a winner if the primary null-to-relation MSE contrast is favorable on fewer than 4 of 6 coordinates or on neither dataset (0 of 3 within either dataset).
Never select a model or hyperparameter using test metrics; a positive screen is not a paper result and must be followed by a separately reviewed frozen replication.
